sources.source_date: document foot: Unofficial – copied from/linked to OAR.STATE.OK.US, September 13, 2020
sources.notes: The rule this source holds is 310:675-7-4, Resident transfers or discharge; the packet's own title for this source names 310:675-7-5.1, which is a different rule in the same chapter (Reports to state and federal agencies). The title is left as the standing packet wrote it — a packet is immutable once a page is built from it, and correcting the label here would put the recipe and the packet out of step with each other. Recorded so the next reader is not misled. Anchors are the rule heading and the heading of the rule that follows; the chapter's contents list sets its entries as 'Section 310:675-7-4', so the bare heading form matches the body and nothing else, and no occurrence key is needed. The rule's own bracketed [Source: Amended at ...] history line falls inside the slice. The document also carries a bracketed editor's remark inserted by whoever assembled it, which is reproduced as served.

sources.notes: Captured whole rather than cut to the two content pages the standing packet holds. The leaflet is a folded brochure, so the extractor's line order follows the panels rather than the reading order, and a page cut would be a judgment about which panels matter — the whole document is a superset, which can only add evidence and never narrows what verifies.
